metaDescription: A West Houston interior restoration: walls, hallway, and bedrooms repaired and repainted with Sherwin-Williams interior coatings as part of Paint It Forward.
h1: Gail's Home — West Houston Interior Restoration
narrative: Gail's 2026 Paint It Forward project didn't stop at the exterior. Inside, the home needed the same care — tired walls, worn trim, and surfaces that hadn't been refreshed in years.

We restored the interior room by room: patching and repairing the drywall, smoothing and texturing where needed, and repainting walls, hallway, and bedrooms with a clean, durable Sherwin-Williams interior system.
The finished interior matched the transformation outside — bright, even, and ready for everyday life. It's the kind of project that reminds us why Paint It Forward exists.
